L001.rule: No heredoc inside $(...): bash 3.2 on macOS cannot parse it

L002.rule: grep -c exits 1 on zero matches; never chain || echo 0 after it

L003.rule: Evidence that something happened must be a file that changes for that reason only

L004.rule: Walk a commit-time check through merge, amend, -v, no -m, commentChar and the first commit before it ships

L005.rule: A hook's exit code only says whether to stop the command; a runner that records what hooks did reads what they printed

L006.rule: A notice the agent must act on stops the command; a line printed by a command that succeeded is a reminder and gets skipped
